query:
SELECT
                        AVG((d.download->>'time_to_first_byte_ms')::float) as "avg_ttfb",
                        AVG((d.download->>'download_speed')::float) as "avg_bandwidth",
                        COUNT(DISTINCT d.worker_name) as "worker_count"
                    FROM worker_data d
                    WHERE d.sub_job_id = $1
